text_block_list.text:
I'm waiting for Sky to show up so we can
start training, but...
Chatter, chatter...

Maybe it's because the academy's big
Tracen Meet is coming up, but
the track is
jam-packed with students.

I can already see Sky skipping practice
with an excuse like, "There's
no point if I
can't run my best."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, hello!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's a fine day for training!
I'm practically
shaking with excitement at
the thought of
running!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, your trainee came all the way here and that's your reaction? Now I'm sad... I thought you'd be happy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nah, even I wouldn't skip training with
our
next race coming up so
soon.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm feeling great today! I'm
itching for a good run!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I'm off to get started! Oh,
and before I forget...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me, okay? I'm
expecting a nice reward for my
efforts.

True to her word, Sky sprints toward the
track energetically.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The track's real crowded today, so you
mind if I join you for some
running?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Sure, no problem. Finding a spot today
can be pretty rough, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay, next—ah.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Do you mind if I join you until
another spot opens up?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's fine. Let's get running,
then.

The usually secretive Sky is going up to
others and joining them for
partner
running out of her own volition.

What's more, everyone she's gone up to
are also her opponents in her
upcoming
race.

Wait... is she running with them to gather
intel? Then...

Not wanting Sky's efforts to go in vain, I
decide to put in my own
share of hard
work as well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whew... How did I do in today's training?
I'd say I did pretty well
considering how
crowded it was, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Anyways,
it'd be nice if I got rewarded for
my hard work. Maybe some
time... right
about now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, what are these notes? Let's see
here...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"The first person you ran with is easily
swayed by her emotions and
has a bad
habit of getting rushed."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"The second person isn't good at running
when someone is marking
her from
behind."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see,
I see. You did well preparing
this reward for me while I
was running.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup, it's perfect. Nobody gets me like you
do.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this reward, our bond has
leveled up again.
Da-dada-daaah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
At this rate,
I might be able to reel in the
big one at my next race...
Just kidding.

Seemingly satisfied with my present, Sky
continues to swipe back and
forth through
my notes.
